app.name: Lasai
app.tagline: A calm, offline space to breathe and ease stress.

home.tagline: Take a few quiet minutes for yourself.
home.measureHint: Read your heart rate with the camera

calm.title: Calm session
calm.readyBody: Follow the circle. Let your breath match its rhythm.
calm.doneBody: You took a moment for yourself.

checkIn.title: Stress check-in
checkIn.intro: Over the last month, how often have you felt this way? There are no right answers.
checkIn.incomplete: Take your time — a few questions are still open.

items.q1: In the last month, how often have you been upset because of something that happened unexpectedly?
items.q2: In the last month, how often have you felt that you were unable to control the important things in your life?
items.q3: In the last month, how often have you felt nervous and stressed?
items.q4: In the last month, how often have you felt confident about your ability to handle your personal problems?
items.q5: In the last month, how often have you felt that things were going your way?
items.q6: In the last month, how often have you found that you could not cope with all the things that you had to do?
items.q7: In the last month, how often have you been able to control irritations in your life?
items.q8: In the last month, how often have you felt that you were on top of things?
items.q9: In the last month, how often have you been angered because of things that happened that were outside of your control?
items.q10: In the last month, how often have you felt difficulties were piling up so high that you could not overcome them?

result.title: Your reflection
result.bodyLow: Things feel fairly manageable at the moment. A short breathing pause can help keep it that way.
result.bodyModerate: There's some pressure in the mix. A few quiet minutes of breathing might bring some ease.
result.bodyHigh: It sounds like a lot is weighing on you. Be gentle with yourself — a calm breathing pause is a kind next step.
result.attribution: Perceived Stress Scale, Cohen et al.
result.disclaimer: This is for self-reflection, not a diagnosis.

history.title: Your history
history.trendAria: Line chart of your perceived-stress score over time
history.emptyBody: Your calm sessions and check-ins will gently gather here.
history.emptyTrend: Complete a couple of check-ins to see your trend.
history.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently removes all your check-ins, notes and sessions from this device. It can't be undone.

ppg.title: Pulse lab
ppg.permissionExplain: Place a fingertip gently over the rear camera and flash, then start. The camera reads colour changes under your skin to estimate your pulse. Frames are processed on your device and never saved or sent.
ppg.weakSignal: Weak signal — press your finger gently over the camera and flash, and hold still.
ppg.iosHint: No flash control here — use good lighting for a cleaner signal.
ppg.errorPermission: Couldn't access the camera. Allow camera permission and try again.
ppg.waveformAria: Live waveform of your pulse signal with detected beats

chest.title: Breathe on your chest
chest.notMedical: This is a wellbeing breathing aid only. It does not measure or diagnose any heart or breathing condition and does not replace a doctor. If you feel chest pain, breathlessness, strong palpitations or faintness, contact a medical professional or emergency services.
chest.guideBody: Lie down and rest the phone flat on your chest. Close your eyes and follow the sounds: a tone that rises means breathe in, a tone that falls means breathe out, a soft tick means hold. A gentle beep marks the end.
chest.guidePrivacy: Motion is processed on your device and never saved or sent. Only the final reading is saved, and only if you choose to.
chest.sessionHint: Rest the phone on your chest and breathe with the tones. You can keep your eyes closed.
chest.bcgNote: A rough estimate from tiny chest movements — easily disturbed by motion. Not a heart measurement.
chest.weakSignal: Weak signal — for a steadier reading, lie still and rest the phone flat on your chest.
chest.noBreaths: Couldn't read a steady breathing rhythm this time. Lie still, rest the phone flat on your chest, and try again.
chest.errorDenied: Motion access was declined. Allow motion permission and try again.
chest.errorStart: Couldn't read the motion sensor. Try again on a phone.

measure.title: Measure my pulse
measure.guideBody: Rest a fingertip gently over the rear camera so it covers both the lens and the flash. Stay still and breathe normally. The whole reading takes about a minute.
measure.guideIos: On iPhone there's no flash control here — sit in good light for a cleaner reading.
measure.guidePrivacy: Frames are processed on your device and never saved or sent.
measure.notMedical: Lasai measures your pulse for wellbeing only. It cannot detect heart attacks, arrhythmias or any heart condition, and it does not replace a doctor. If you have a heart condition, or feel chest pain, strong palpitations, breathlessness or faintness, contact a medical professional or emergency services.
measure.hintTooBright: Too bright — press a little lighter
measure.hintTooDark: Cover the lens fully (and the flash)
measure.hintTooMuchMotion: Too much movement — hold your hand still
measure.stressExplain: Estimated from the variation between your heartbeats. Lower variation tends to go with more arousal. It's a rough signal, not medical advice.
measure.noStressBody: We couldn't get a steady enough reading to estimate stress this time. For a reflection on stress, try the check-in.
measure.failBody: The signal stayed too weak to trust. Cover the lens and flash fully, hold still, and try again.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.body: Everything stays on your device. Lasai has no account, no server, and collects nothing.
privacy.note: Everything stays on your device. Lasai has no account, no server, and collects nothing.
